ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 35% high-intensity white/light-grey distal patches against 65% low-intensity black central and proximal pigmentation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black pigmentation centered at the peduncle connection extending to the medial trailing edge. Large, contiguous high-intensity white blobs occupy the distal thirds of both lobes, transitioning to the center via high-frequency black/white mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with an estimated aperture angle of 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire visible boundary; high-frequency peaks with 3-7 pixel amplitude are most pronounced on the mid-to-distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight concavity just before the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups (barnacle colonies) concentrated at the extreme distal tips and along the leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three distinct, near-parallel high-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) on the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the terminal tips and visible rake marks on the ventral surface of the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Isolated white focal point (circular pixel cluster) located in the lower-left quadrant of the central dark pigmentation zone.
